history.summary: A large 1,991 sqft 4BR at The Florida, a 2000-built 99-year leasehold in Hougang, asking $2.5M. Old leasehold, oversized unit, 1.22km from MRT and a low score (308) — the cheap-looking PSF masks a $2.5M, above-band, lease-decaying, illiquid product.
history.rating_rationale: 26-year-old 99-yr leasehold with ~73 years left and decaying; $1,256 psf is low only because the unit is 1,991 sqft, pushing total price to $2.5M above the liquid band. 15-min / 1.22km walk to Hougang MRT weakens demand, and the oversized layout shrinks the buyer pool. No URA data, but the structural strikes (age + size + transit distance + price) all point one way.
